patterns.message: Reach the daemon only through @compass/client — the owned compass.v1 door.

deniedGlobals.setTimeout: Fixed sleeps/timers are non-deterministic and flake tests (rule://go-no-sleep-in-test, same discipline in TS). Event-gate on the observed state; use Effect.sleep (TestClock-testable) in Effect code. A genuine timer (fetch-abort timeout, abortable backoff) justifies itself with `// biome-ignore lint/style/noRestrictedGlobals: <reason>`.
deniedGlobals.setInterval: Polling on a wall-clock interval is non-deterministic and flakes tests. Event-gate on the observed state; or `// biome-ignore lint/style/noRestrictedGlobals: <reason>` for a genuine production interval.
